narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The last two digits are enough for eight, the same as for four.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Take one hundred sixteen. Sixteen is a multiple of eight, but one hundred sixteen leaves four over.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>One hundred is not a multiple of eight, so the hundreds digit still matters.
